_monitoring_mandate.posture: MONITOR + RECOMMEND + ASK. Ryan makes the call; the desk's job is to bring him a decision at the right moment with the numbers attached. _monitoring_mandate.THE_ONE_EXCEPTION: The unconditional hard premium backstops still EXECUTE without waiting (-65% at 21-45 DTE, -70% above 45 DTE, and the -50% cut once a contract is inside 21 DTE, per the 2026-08-05 exit-method amendment). They exist precisely so a true loser cannot ride toward zero during the hours or days it may take Ryan to see a message and reply. If a backstop executes, notify him immediately AFTER, with the reason. Everything short of a backstop is a recommendation, not an action. Ryan can lift this exception at any time; until he does it stands, because a 15-minute ask-first loop with no floor is how a -50% becomes a -90%.
_monitoring_mandate.HONEST_LIMIT_TELL_HIM_AGAIN_IF_ASKED: This is a 15-minute scheduled cadence during market hours (9:30-16:00 ET), NOT continuous tick-by-tick monitoring. Two real consequences: an intraday spike can round-trip entirely between two runs and never be seen, and an overnight or weekend gap is not covered at all -- the first run of the next session sees the result, not the move. Sizing and expectations must assume gaps between runs. Do not promise Ryan coverage this system does not have.
_monitoring_mandate.SILENCE_RULE_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PUSHING: At ~26 runs/day, an un-deduped mandate turns into 26 notifications a day and Ryan stops reading them -- which destroys the mandate's whole purpose. So: notify ONLY on a trigger below FIRING or UN-FIRING, never on routine state. Each position carries a _notify_state that every run OVERWRITES in place. Before pushing, check last_notified_trigger: if the SAME trigger is still the live one and nothing material has changed, DO NOT notify again -- update the timestamp and mark and stay silent. Re-notify only when a DIFFERENT trigger fires, a fired trigger un-fires, or the recommendation itself changes. A position quietly working is not news; the journal and the EOD report already carry it.
_monitoring_mandate.WHAT_A_RECOMMENDATION_MUST_CONTAIN: Never send a bare 'consider selling'. Every recommendation carries: the trigger that fired and its measured level; current mark, bid/ask and the spread as % of mid (this determines what an exit actually nets and on RBRK it is punishing); P/L in $ and %; DTE and the theta burn per day; the underlying's level versus its written invalidation; the specific alternatives with their trade-offs; and a plain-language RECOMMENDATION with a reason.
